package.author: Paul Giralt

en-US.author: Paul Giralt
en-US.longDescription: TranslatorX is a focused desktop tool for understanding Cisco collaboration signaling and call behavior, offering native multi-window trace investigation, call and media analysis, remote collection from Unified CM, Expressway, and CUBE, and evidence-grounded AI analysis.
en-US.name: TranslatorX
en-US.releaseNotes:
TranslatorX 26.1.4 is now available. It promotes the verified 26.1.4-beta.4 feature set unchanged to Stable.
Highlights include endpoint registration diagnostics, SIP session comparison, negotiated media codecs, improved remote collection and log importing, streamlined AI analysis, and updated application libraries and bundled OpenSSH. Packages remain signed for macOS, Windows, and Linux with signed updater metadata and versioned SBOMs.
Full feature notes, system requirements, checksums, and versioned SBOM links:
https://www.translatorx.org/releasenotes.html#v26-1-4
